requests.zh: 提亮整张照片。
requests.en: Lighten the entire image

requests.zh: 提亮照片。
requests.en: Brighten image.

requests.zh: 提高曝光。
requests.en: Increase exposure

requests.zh: 大幅提亮照片。
requests.en: Brighten the photo a lot.

requests.zh: 请把整张照片稍微提亮一点。
requests.en: Slightly brighten the whole photograph.

requests.zh: 把照片提亮一点。
requests.en: brighten the picture a bit

requests.zh: 请提亮照片。
requests.en: Please brighten the image.

requests.zh: 把照片稍微提亮一点。
requests.en: Brighten the image slightly

requests.zh: 保持这张照片原样，不要改变明暗、色彩或构图。
requests.en: Keep this photograph exactly as it is. Do not change its brightness, colours or framing.

requests.zh: 稍微压暗整张照片，保留色彩、构图和现有细节。
requests.en: Darken the whole photograph a little. Keep its colours, framing and visible detail.

requests.zh: 稍微提亮整张照片，保留色彩、构图和现有细节。
requests.en: Brighten the whole photograph a little. Keep its colours, framing and visible detail.

requests.zh: 我只想把这张照片提亮，谢谢！
requests.en: I would just like this brightened! Thanks!

requests.zh: 请压暗照片。
requests.en: Please darken the image.

requests.zh: 把棕褐色照片变成彩色照片。
requests.en: Change from sepia tones to color picture.

requests.zh: 稍微压暗照片。
requests.en: darken the image slightly

requests.zh: 大幅提亮照片。
requests.en: Brighten image a lot.

requests.zh: 请降低亮度。
requests.en: Please, reduce the brightness

requests.zh: 请保持这张照片原样，不需要任何修图或自动增强。
requests.en: Keep this photograph exactly as supplied. Do not edit or automatically enhance it.

requests.zh: 请纠正照片曝光不足的问题，让整体光照恢复自然，保留原有颜色。
requests.en: Correct the underexposure to restore natural overall lighting while retaining the original colours.

requests.zh: 请明显提亮暗部，保留主体和细节，其他效果保持自然。
requests.en: Please noticeably lift the shadows while preserving the subject and detail; keep other aspects natural.

requests.zh: 请轻微提亮暗部，保留主体和细节，其他效果保持自然。
requests.en: Please slightly lift the shadows while preserving the subject and detail; keep other aspects natural.

requests.zh: 请明显压暗阴影，保留主体和细节，其他效果保持自然。
requests.en: Please noticeably darken the shadows while preserving the subject and detail; keep other aspects natural.

requests.zh: 请轻微压暗阴影，保留主体和细节，其他效果保持自然。
requests.en: Please slightly darken the shadows while preserving the subject and detail; keep other aspects natural.

requests.zh: 请移除照片中的人物，并自然补全背景。
requests.en: Remove the people in the photograph and naturally fill the background.

requests.zh: 请将人物身后的背景换成雪山。
requests.en: Replace the background behind the person with snowy mountains.

requests.zh: 只把人物的衣服换成红色，其他区域保持原样。
requests.en: Change only the person's clothing to red; leave all other regions unchanged.

requests.zh: 把人物抠出来，导出透明背景图片。
requests.en: Cut out the person and export the photograph with a transparent background.

requests.zh: 请移除人物，保留并补全原来的环境。
requests.en: Remove the person while retaining and filling the original surroundings.

requests.zh: 在人物身旁添加一只白色小狗。
requests.en: Add a small white dog beside the person.

requests.zh: 在画面前景添加一只红色行李箱。
requests.en: Add a red suitcase to the foreground.

requests.zh: 只修掉脸上的小瑕疵，头发和背景不要改。
requests.en: Retouch small facial blemishes only; leave the hair and background unchanged.

requests.zh: 请把天空替换成有晚霞的天空，地面完全不改。
requests.en: Replace the sky with a sunset sky while leaving the ground completely unchanged.

requests.zh: 把人物背景换成室内摄影棚。
requests.en: Replace the background behind the person with an indoor photography studio.

requests.zh: 只把人物的帽子改成红色，其他颜色不变。
requests.en: Change only the person's hat to red without changing other colours.

requests.zh: 只修改照片上半部分的颜色，其他像素保持原样。
requests.en: Change colours only in the upper half of the photo; leave all other pixels unchanged.

requests.zh: 请移除人物并自然修补被遮挡的背景。
requests.en: Remove the person and naturally reconstruct the background hidden behind them.

requests.zh: 移除照片中的房屋，并自然补全周围场景。
requests.en: Remove the house and naturally fill the surrounding scene.

requests.zh: 只把屋顶换成鲜红色，其他颜色都不变。
requests.en: Change only the roof to bright red; leave all other colours unchanged.

requests.zh: 在前景添加一个戴黄色帽子的行人。
requests.en: Add a person wearing a yellow hat in the foreground.

requests.zh: 在画面右下角添加一只黑猫。
requests.en: Add a black cat in the lower-right corner of the photograph.

requests.zh: 移除小船和船上的人，并补全水面。
requests.en: Remove the small boat and its passenger, filling the water surface naturally.

requests.zh: 在照片中央添加一棵开花的树。
requests.en: Add a flowering tree at the centre of the photograph.

requests.zh: 在画面上方添加文字“旅行日记”。
requests.en: Add the text "Travel Diary" across the top of the photograph.

requests.zh: 请把整张照片大幅调暗，保留原有颜色和主体细节。
requests.en: Darken the whole photograph substantially while retaining its original colours and subject detail.

requests.zh: 请显著提亮这张照片，保留自然色彩和细节，不要明显放大噪声。
requests.en: Brighten this photograph substantially while preserving natural colour and detail, without markedly amplifying noise.

requests.zh: 明显提亮暗部，同时保持自然颜色和可辨认细节，不要增加明显的颗粒或色斑。
requests.en: Brighten the shadows noticeably while preserving natural colours and recognizable detail, without adding obvious grain or coloured blotches.

requests.zh: 把眼窝和胡须的暗侧打开一些，树丛亮斑原样保留。
requests.en: Open up the shade around the eyes and beard; leave the bright patches in the trees alone.

requests.zh: 把人物暗面再压深一点，保留背光的亮边。
requests.en: Deepen the shaded side of the person a little, keeping the backlit rim.

requests.zh: 让整张背光照片亮一些，人物和树林都要有变化。
requests.en: Make the whole backlit photograph brighter, including the person and the trees.

requests.zh: 压低整幅照片的亮度，别把头发或背景的纹理压没。
requests.en: Bring the brightness down across the frame and preserve texture in the hair and background.

requests.zh: 脸和衣服暗处需要多一点亮度，水面反光别加亮。
requests.en: Give the darker faces and clothes a bit more light, keeping the bright reflections as they are.

requests.zh: 衣服阴影再沉一点，水面的高光不用压。
requests.en: Make the shadows in the clothes deeper, without reducing the highlights in the water.

requests.zh: 人、水面、天空都比现在亮一档，保留云和衣纹。
requests.en: Take the whole scene a stop brighter so the couple, water and sky all lift, retaining clouds and clothing texture.

requests.zh: 请把整幅湖边照片曝光调低，人物、水面和云层一起收一点。
requests.en: Lower the exposure of the entire lakeside photo, including the couple, reflections and clouds.

requests.zh: 提一下山谷前景暗处，让枝叶好辨认，晚霞不动。
requests.en: Recover a little light in the shaded foreground of the valley and leave the pink sky alone.

requests.zh: 压暗谷底的阴影，让前景层次更深，天空和暖色岩壁保持。
requests.en: Pull down the dark tones on the valley floor; keep the sky and warm rock faces as they are.

requests.zh: 给整张山谷风景加一点曝光，植被和天空一起变亮。
requests.en: Give the valley scene a small overall exposure lift so both the vegetation and sky brighten.

requests.zh: 整张风景压低一档曝光，包括远山和天，不改变它们的色调。
requests.en: Take the whole landscape a little darker, including the distant rocks and sky, while keeping their colours.

requests.zh: 给近处树影和草地暗面补光，云和亮水别一起抬。
requests.en: Add light to the shadowed trees and grass in front; keep the bright water and clouds at their current brightness.

requests.zh: 树影和近岸要再深一些，别碰水面反光或云。
requests.en: I want deeper shadows in the trees and near shore; keep the reflections and clouds untouched.

requests.zh: 整体偏暗，让前景、水面和天空都亮一点。
requests.en: The picture feels dark overall. Lift the foreground, water and sky together.

requests.zh: 整体曝光有点高，整张压暗，保留草地和云纹。
requests.en: The overall exposure is too high; darken the entire image while retaining grass and cloud detail.

requests.zh: 让帽檐下暗掉的五官更清楚，灯牌保留现在的亮度。
requests.en: Reveal more of the face beneath the shaded cap without changing the lit sign.

requests.zh: 舞台人像的暗部要更深，灯牌亮处别动。
requests.en: Give the stage portrait stronger dark shadows, leaving the illuminated sign alone.

requests.zh: 把整个舞台照片提亮一点，黑衣、灯牌都适当抬。
requests.en: Brighten the whole stage photograph a little, raising both the dark outfit and illuminated sign.

requests.zh: 这张舞台照整幅都太亮了，请全面降亮度。
requests.en: The stage shot is too bright throughout; bring the overall brightness down.

requests.zh: 雪地下面的暗草看不清，把阴影抬高一些，白雪还是原来的白。
requests.en: Lift the shaded grass beneath the snow; keep the white snow at its current level.

requests.zh: 把树下和石头阴面的暗调收低一点，亮雪别动。
requests.en: Take the shaded tones under the trees and rocks down a bit; leave the bright snow alone.

requests.zh: 整张雪路太阴沉，曝光整体加一些，天和地都亮。
requests.en: The entire snowy path scene looks dim. Add exposure across both sky and ground.

requests.zh: 整张雪景往暗处调一点，包括蓝天和积雪，留住雪纹。
requests.en: Lower overall brightness in the snow scene, including blue sky and snow, retaining the snow texture.

requests.zh: 把建筑之间的阴影撑开一些，霓虹招牌的亮度保持。
requests.en: Lift the dark lanes between the buildings while holding the neon signs at their current brightness.

requests.zh: 建筑阴影再暗一档，高处的灯光保持。
requests.en: Make the building shadows a notch darker; keep the high lights as they are.

requests.zh: 把整个街景提高曝光，街道和亮招牌都可以更亮。
requests.en: Increase the exposure of the entire street scene, so both the roadway and bright signs are lighter.

requests.zh: 让整幅街景都略暗一档，天空和招牌也跟着变暗。
requests.en: Lower the whole street scene a bit, with the sky and signs getting darker too.

requests.zh: 给桌边黑衣和脸的暗侧一点光，保留吊灯亮度。
requests.en: Give the dark jackets and shaded faces a little more light; leave the chandelier alone.

requests.zh: 黑衣和桌下阴影压一点，吊灯仍旧亮。
requests.en: Darken the shadows in the jackets and below the table while keeping the lamp bright.

requests.zh: 餐厅合照的整体曝光往上提，桌灯和人一起亮。
requests.en: Raise the overall exposure of the group photograph so the people and lamps brighten together.

requests.zh: 请把整个餐厅合照调暗一些，包括灯附近的部分。
requests.en: Darken the whole restaurant group photo a little, including the areas near the lamps.

requests.zh: 让船坞暗处可辨一些，亮浪和夕阳保留。
requests.en: Raise the shadows in the dock area and keep the bright waves and setting sun unchanged.

requests.zh: 把码头暗部往下收一档，天边暖亮的区域不变。
requests.en: Lower the shadow tones at the dock a notch; keep the warm bright horizon as it is.

requests.zh: 给全幅海港照加整体亮度，天空、水和船都提一提。
requests.en: Brighten the full harbour photograph, lifting sky, water and boats together.

requests.zh: 整幅海港图曝光往下收一点，水和天也要变暗。
requests.en: Reduce exposure across the harbour photo, making the water and sky darker too.

requests.zh: 只提亮窗边人脸的背光面，别顺手把窗户抬亮。
requests.en: Lighten the shaded side of the face without brightening the window.

requests.zh: 只压暗墙角和脸的暗侧，窗户高光原样。
requests.en: Darken the shaded cheek and corner of the room while leaving window highlights as they are.

requests.zh: 人、室内和窗外整体都要变亮一点，保住层次。
requests.en: Make the entire indoor photograph a bit brighter, including the face, room and view through the window.

requests.zh: 把窗边照片整体曝光稍微调低，脸、房间和窗都一起变暗。
requests.en: Bring the exposure down slightly across the whole window photograph, including face, room and window.

requests.zh: 对比度调低一点，整体亮度尽量别变。
requests.en: Reduce contrast a little without changing overall brightness.

requests.zh: 给这张照片加棕褐复古色，亮度随原图。
requests.en: Add an old brown sepia look, keeping the existing brightness.

requests.zh: 去掉右边多余的路人，其他保持。
requests.en: Remove the extra person on the right and leave everything else as it is.

requests.zh: 请看看整体曝光合不合适，再决定是否调整。
requests.en: See if the exposure is appropriate before deciding whether to adjust it.

requests.zh: 别提亮或压暗任何部分，维持原图。
requests.en: Leave the photo as is; do not brighten or darken any part.

requests.zh: 脸上暗部抬高、天上高光压低，两项都做。
requests.en: Lift the shadows on the face and lower the sky highlights, both in the same edit.

requests.zh: 同一块阴影既要变亮也要变暗。
requests.en: Make the same shadows both lighter and darker.

requests.zh: 不要改阴影，只把蓝天更饱和一点。
requests.en: Keep shadows unchanged and only boost saturation in the sky.

requests.zh: 提高彩色的鲜艳度，亮度不要变。
requests.en: Make colours more vivid, without changing brightness.

requests.zh: 把白墙的偏黄校正一下，保留光线。
requests.en: Correct the yellow cast of the wall while preserving the lighting.

requests.zh: 只把最亮的地方收一点，别动暗部和中间调。
requests.en: Pull back only the brightest highlights; keep shadows and midtones unchanged.

requests.zh: 这张照片看起来怪，能调整到自然一些吗？
requests.en: Could you make this look more natural?

requests.zh: 给毕业照中两张脸没照到太阳的地方加些亮度，明亮的天空保持。
requests.en: Give the unlit parts of both faces a little light, with the bright sky left alone.

requests.zh: 毕业照的暗面想再沉一点，天空和受光的衣服留住。
requests.en: Make the shaded parts of the graduation photo deeper while retaining the sky and lit clothing.

requests.zh: 把这张毕业照整张提亮，脸和背景、天空都要有变化。
requests.en: Raise the whole graduation photograph a little, including faces, background and sky.

requests.zh: 整张毕业照偏亮，收一点整体曝光，别压没衣服纹理。
requests.en: Take the entire graduation photo down a little in exposure, preserving clothing texture.

requests.zh: 把合照里偏暗的脸和衣服带亮一些，墙上灯的亮度保持。
requests.en: Bring up the shadowed faces and clothes in the group without raising the wall lamp.

requests.zh: 要加深人像暗调，吊灯的亮部不用变。
requests.en: Give the people deeper shadows while leaving the bright lamp alone.

requests.zh: 合照太暗，让人和墙、灯附近都更亮一点。
requests.en: The group photograph is too dim. Brighten the whole frame including people, walls and areas near the lamp.

requests.zh: 把合照整体再暗一点，墙面和人都一起收。
requests.en: Lower the whole group photograph a little, darkening both the wall and people.

requests.zh: 把赛车下面与近处阴影抬亮些，明亮车漆和天保留。
requests.en: Lighten the shade under the race cars and in front, keeping the bright paint and sky unchanged.

requests.zh: 车辆下面的阴影稍深一点，车漆高光和云保持。
requests.en: Take the shadows beneath the cars a bit deeper, retaining paint highlights and clouds.

requests.zh: 场地、车和天空一起提亮一些，保住车身和云层的细节。
requests.en: Brighten the entire race scene, including ground, cars and sky, while retaining paint and cloud detail.

requests.zh: 整张车场照片降低一点曝光，保留原有色彩和可见细节。
requests.en: Give the whole race scene a small reduction in exposure, keeping the colours and visible detail.

requests.zh: 让湖边近处树石的暗部能看清一点，天边晚霞别跟着变亮。
requests.en: Reveal a little more in the dark foreground by the lake, keeping the sunset unchanged.

requests.zh: 把湖边前景暗面收深一些，天空的日落渐变保持。
requests.en: Darken the foreground shadow tones at the lake and retain the sunset gradient.

requests.zh: 整幅湖边图增加一些曝光，前景、远山和天空都抬起来。
requests.en: Increase exposure across the lake scene, lifting foreground, mountains and sky together.

requests.zh: 整张湖边照整体调暗，天和地一起往下收一点。
requests.en: Darken the lake photo across the frame, bringing down both sky and ground.

requests.zh: 把楼梯下没照到光的地方提起来，楼上的灯别跟着亮。
requests.en: Put more light into the shade under the stairs; leave the upstairs lights at the same level.

requests.zh: 把最暗的层次轻轻往上拉，高光按原来的样子。
requests.en: Bring the lowest tones up gently while holding the highlights in place.

requests.zh: 只让画面里的暗处沉下去一点，受光的地方留原样。
requests.en: Let the shaded parts sink a little darker; keep illuminated areas where they are.

requests.zh: 压低深灰区域的亮度，不调整整体曝光。
requests.en: Lower brightness in the deep greys without adjusting overall exposure.

requests.zh: 整体比现在亮一点，暗部和亮部都一起变化。
requests.en: Make the image brighter across the board, not just in its shadows.

requests.zh: 从天空到地面都增加一些亮度，保留原色。
requests.en: Raise the brightness from sky to ground while keeping the original colours.

requests.zh: 整幅照片收暗半档，天空也要一起收。
requests.en: Take the entire shot half a stop down, including the sky.

requests.zh: 室内这张整体太亮，连白墙也一起暗一点。
requests.en: This indoor shot is too bright all over. Bring it all down, including the white wall.

requests.zh: 亮度不动，只把色温调冷一些。
requests.en: Leave brightness as it is and make the white balance a little cooler.

requests.zh: 先提阴影，再给整张加点复古棕色。
requests.en: Lift the shadows and then add a vintage brown tone to the whole picture.

requests.zh: 只把阳光照到的地方压一点，树荫不用变。
requests.en: Tone down the sunlit areas only; keep the shade unchanged.

requests.zh: 照片还是原来的样子就好，别动暗处或亮处。
requests.en: Keep the photo the way it is, without changes to dark or bright areas.

requests.zh: 给脸上背光的部分补一点亮度，已经亮的地方保持。
requests.en: Open up the dim side of the face a bit and leave the lit side alone.

requests.zh: 把画面里的暗处提起来一截，天上亮云原样保留。
requests.en: Bring up the darker tones so more is visible, leaving the bright clouds as they are.

requests.zh: 把树下的阴影压得更深，天和水面不用变。
requests.en: Deepen the shade below the trees and leave the sky and water as they are.

requests.zh: 拉低暗部的亮度，让人像的阴影更有深度，白衫别变。
requests.en: Pull the shadow tones down for a deeper portrait, leaving the white shirt alone.

requests.zh: 这张整体太暗了，整幅图的曝光提一档。
requests.en: The whole frame is too dim. Bring the exposure up a notch across the image.

requests.zh: 全画面再亮一点，包括前景、人物和天空，保留层次。
requests.en: Give the entire photo a little more light, including the foreground, people and sky, while keeping tonal detail.

requests.zh: 整张稍微压暗一些，别只改阴影。
requests.en: Make the whole photograph a little darker, including its lighter areas.

requests.zh: 整体曝光太高，整幅画面往回收一档。
requests.en: The shot is too bright overall. Bring the exposure down across the frame.

requests.zh: 降低整体对比度，尽量保持平均亮度。
requests.en: Reduce overall contrast while keeping the average brightness about the same.

requests.zh: 提亮脸上的暗部，再把天空的高光压下来。
requests.en: Lift the shadowed parts of the face and also pull down the bright sky highlights.

requests.zh: 看看要不要调整曝光，保留现在的气氛。
requests.en: See if the exposure needs a change, while preserving the current mood.

requests.zh: 暗部和亮部都原样保留，什么也别改。
requests.en: Leave the shadows and highlights exactly as they are and make no changes.

requests.zh: 请原样保留，不要编辑。
requests.en: Keep the picture unchanged.

requests.zh: 请把背景里的路人移除。
requests.en: Remove the person in the background.

requests.zh: 加一点棕褐色的复古色调。
requests.en: Add a subtle brown sepia tone.

requests.zh: 把整张照片的曝光明显提高。
requests.en: Raise the exposure of the whole photograph noticeably.

requests.zh: 显著压暗阴影，保持高光。
requests.en: Darken the shadows noticeably, preserving highlights.

requests.zh: 把暗部提亮，亮部原样保留。
requests.en: Lift the shadows and keep the highlights unchanged.

requests.zh: 暗部只提一点点，但同一处暗部也要大幅提亮。
requests.en: Lift the shadows a little, but also lift the same shadows substantially.

requests.zh: 明显提亮阴影，不要提亮高光。
requests.en: Lift the shadows noticeably, but do not brighten the highlights.
